author: dr_ingky
caption: Dry or sensitive skin? Some CeraVe products may work well for your skin, while others can be too drying or irritating. • Foaming Facial Cleanser → Skip for dry/sensitive skin. It can strip too much moisture and leave skin feeling dry. • Resurfacing Retinol Serum → Skip if your skin barrier is damaged. Keep if you have active acne, but it may still cause dryness or irritation. • Hydrating Facial Cleanser → Keep. Ceramides and hyaluronic acid help cleanse while maintaining skin hydration. • PM Facial Moisturizing Lotion → Keep. Niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, and ceramides help hydrate and support the skin barrier overnight. Save this for later.
